massEmpty.sourceNote: Wikipedia's infobox states 3.8 kg empty with no inline citation of its own; the archived Russian enthusiast site armoury-online.ru gives 3.1 kg without the suppressor and 3.8 kg with it fitted, which resolves the discrepancy, but neither is a manufacturer source.

length.sourceNote: Stock extended, suppressor not fitted. Folded, the AK-9 is 465 mm; with the quick-detachable suppressor fitted it is 881 mm extended or 646 mm folded. Both Wikipedia's infobox and armoury-online.ru give matching figures, but neither is a manufacturer source.

barrelLength.sourceNote: Matched by Wikipedia's infobox and armoury-online.ru; neither is a manufacturer source.

cyclicRate.sourceNote: Wikipedia's infobox states 700-750 rounds per minute with no inline citation; armoury-online.ru states 750-800. The ranges only partly overlap.

capacity.sourceNote: Wikipedia's infobox figure, no inline citation of its own.
